blueprint.summary: Houston Texans hold $7.76M in 2026 OverTheCap space ($7.76M effective) and -$40.47M projected for 2027.
blueprint.executiveSummary: Nick Caserio and the Texans front office hold $7.76M in gross 2026 cap space ($7.76M effective), while 2027 currently projects at -$40.47M over an estimated $326M cap ceiling. Rolling unused 2026 cap space 1-for-1 under CBA Article 13 ($4M–$6M target) helps manage scheduled cap escalations for Danielle Hunter, Nico Collins, Will Anderson Jr., C.J. Stroud.

strategicPillars.title: 1. CBA Article 13 Rollover Bridge ($4M–$6M Target vs. -$40.47M 2027 Projection)
strategicPillars.detail: Unused 2026 cap space carries over dollar-for-dollar into 2027, buffering Houston's projected 2027 ledger without forcing premature void-year restructures.

strategicPillars.title: 2. Prorated Base Salary & Option-Bonus Architecture
strategicPillars.detail: Converting base salary or option bonuses spreads cap charges across up to 5 years (including void years) while preserving weekly in-season flexibility.
